frontends.name: app.frankencoin.com
frontends.creator: Frankencoin Association
frontends.notes: Maintained by the Frankencoin Association. Mint and repay positions, use the savings module and trade Frankencoin Shares (FCS). Source code, API and indexer are public.

frontends.name: zchf.app
frontends.creator: dnbjn
frontends.notes: Self-hosted frontend, API, and Ponder indexer. Reworked UI with dark/light mode, added host information on the Earn page, and routes indexer access through a failover-enabled API. Deployed on Railway behind a Cloudflare Tunnel.

frontends.name: frankencoin.win
frontends.creator: DiumPay
frontends.notes: Independent open-source frontend by DiumPay. Multi-language support, fast and lightweight. Features include a non-custodial, no-KYC cross-chain swap for ZCHF users.

frontends.name: frankenterminal.app
frontends.creator: xdecentralix
frontends.notes: Independent open-source fork of the canonical dapp with a cypherpunk-terminal aesthetic (dark-mode only). Self-hosted frontend, API, and Ponder indexer, deployed on Railway.
